state_of_comparison: There is NO established semi-supervised benchmark on CHAOS-CT (liver-only, CT). The CHAOS semi-supervised literature is almost entirely (a) on CHAOS-MR (T1/T2-SPIR), (b) multi-organ (liver + L/R kidney + spleen), and (c) framed as semi-supervised DOMAIN ADAPTATION (MR<->CT, target modality has ~20% labels). Pure from-scratch semi-supervised segmentation on CHAOS-CT liver is essentially unreported - people use LiTS for that. Options for the paper: switch this dataset to CHAOS-MR (4 organs, has a real semi-sup literature), or to LiTS (standard semi-sup liver CT benchmark), or keep CHAOS-CT as an 'also-evaluated' dataset with only the loose references below.
